## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-6: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Implementation
Create tests/scripts/test-design-lint.sh with:
1. design-lint.sh --report produces per-violation-class count output
2. design-lint.sh exits 0 when no DESIGN.md present (skip/no-op)
3. design-lint.sh reads path from config
4. Retargeting verification: grep -rln 'design-notes' plugins/dso/ | grep -v migrate returns 0 matches

chmod +x the test file.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Test file exists and executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-design-lint.sh
- [ ] At least 3 test functions — Verify: grep -c 'test_' tests/scripts/test-design-lint.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 3)}'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
data.title: Write tests for design-lint.sh and reference retargeting verification
